about: Ardagh Metal Packaging is a Luxembourg-based supplier of metal beverage cans, producing aluminium and steel cans for beer, soft drinks, energy drinks and other beverages from plants in Europe and the Americas, for customers such as Coca-Cola, Heineken, PepsiCo and Carlsberg. Revenue is about 5 billion dollars. It listed on the NYSE (AMBP) in 2021 after a SPAC merger, and is majority owned by Ardagh Group. B2B packaging brand with no consumer awareness, though its cans reach consumers widely.

Global paper-based packaging group created in July 2024 by the merger of Ireland's Smurfit Kappa and US-based WestRock, producing corrugated boxes, containerboard, folding cartons and specialty paper packaging for consumer goods, e-commerce, food and industrial customers. Annual revenue is around 30 billion dollars, with roughly 100,000 employees and operations in over 40 countries. Headquartered in Dublin and listed on the NYSE (SW) and London (SKG). Customers are mainly brand owners and retailers, so it is B2B with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Smurfit Westrock
wiki.text: Smurfit Westrock plc is an Irish company based in Dublin, Ireland, that manufactures corrugated and paper-based packaging. Its stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange.

about: Venture Global is a US liquefied natural gas producer, based in Arlington, Virginia, that operates Calcasieu Pass and Plaquemines LNG export plants in Louisiana, selling LNG to buyers in Europe and Asia under long-term contracts. Founded in 2013, it listed on the NYSE (VG) in January 2025. Customers are utilities and energy traders. B2B with no consumer profile.

Enbridge is a Canadian energy infrastructure company, based in Calgary, operating crude oil pipelines (Mainline), natural gas transmission and utilities (Enbridge Gas Ontario), and renewables, and it moves around 30% of North America's crude. Revenue is about C$50 billion. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (ENB). B2B and utility, with consumer visibility in Ontario gas.

wiki.title: Enbridge
wiki.text: Enbridge Inc. is a Canadian pipeline and energy company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Enbridge owns and operates pipelines throughout Canada and the United States, transporting crude oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids, and also generates renewable energy. Enbridge's pipeline system is the longest in North America and the largest oil export pipeline network in the world. Its crude oil system consists of 28,661 kilometres (17,809 miles) of pipelines. Its 38,300 kilometre (23,800 mile) natural gas pipeline system connects multiple Canadian provinces, several US states, and the Gulf of Mexico. The company was formed by Imperia

about: Chart Industries is a US industrial gas equipment maker, with a Crunchbase location of Ball Ground, Georgia (Atlanta area), designing and manufacturing process equipment for cryogenic gas handling, such as storage tanks, heat exchangers, LNG liquefaction equipment, hydrogen and carbon capture systems. Customers are energy, industrial gas and chemical firms. It was listed on the NYSE (GTLS), and in 2025 Baker Hughes agreed to acquire it for about $13.6 billion. B2B industrial brand, with no consumer awareness.

World's largest wind turbine manufacturer by installed capacity, based in Aarhus, Denmark, listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen (VWS). It designs, makes, installs and services onshore and offshore wind turbines and sells long-term service contracts to utilities and developers in more than 80 countries, with about 30,000 employees and revenue of EUR 15-17 billion. Founded in 1945. Competes with Siemens Gamesa, GE Vernova and Chinese makers. B2B brand, well known among energy investors and in Denmark, and linked to renewable energy sponsorship.

wiki.title: Vestas
wiki.text: Vestas Wind Systems A/S is a Danish manufacturer, seller, installer, and servicer of wind turbines that was founded in 1945. The company operates manufacturing plants in Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands, Taiwan, India, Italy, Romania, the United Kingdom, Spain, Sweden, Norway, Australia, China, Brazil, Poland and the United States, and employs 37,000 people globally. As of 2026, it is the seventh largest wind turbine company in the world.

about: GardaWorld is a Montreal-area (Saint-Laurent, Quebec) private security services group, founded by Stephan Crete, providing armoured cash transport, security guarding, cash management, crisis and risk consulting and protective services for governments and corporates in about 45 countries. It has roughly 130,000 employees and revenue above $9 billion. Taken private in 2020 and owned by Crete with Apax Partners. B2B, little consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: GardaWorld
wiki.text: GardaWorld Corporation is a Canadian private security firm, headquartered in Montreal, Quebec, with 120,000 employees as of January 2022. Its U.S. business name is United American Security LLC, dba GardaWorld. GardaWorld International Protective Services, the international division of the company, began operations in 1984. GardaWorld Security Corporation was established as Trans-Québec Security Inc. by Stephan Crétier in 1995, who invested initially $25,000. The company runs physical security guard services and armoured car services globally.

about: Securitas is a Swedish security services group, founded in 1934 and headquartered in Stockholm, with roughly 350,000 employees in about 45 countries. It provides guarding, electronic security, fire and safety, and risk-management services to corporate, retail, industrial and government clients, earning contract revenue of roughly SEK 150 billion a year. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (SECU B). Strong B2B brand in Europe and North America, but not a consumer brand.

wiki.title: Securitas
wiki.what: Roman goddess of security and stability
wiki.text: In Roman mythology, Securitas was the goddess of security and stability, especially the security of the Roman Empire. On coinage Securitas was usually depicted leaning on a column. She first appears on a coin in 62 AD and then becomes a usual coin motif in the following centuries. On Sardinia during the Roman imperial period, a Latin inscription described the tomb of Titus Vinius as a shrine of Securitas.

about: Resideo Technologies is a Scottsdale, Arizona maker of home comfort and security products such as Honeywell Home thermostats, First Alert smoke detectors, and distributor ADI Global Distribution. It was spun off from Honeywell in 2018 and is listed on NYSE (REZI). Customers are installers, retailers and homeowners. The Honeywell Home brand is well known in the US. Revenue comes from product sales and distribution, with about 6 billion dollars in annual sales. The Honeywell Home brand is licensed from Honeywell and widely recognised by US homeowners.

LCI Industries is a supplier to the recreational vehicle and manufactured housing industries, headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana, listed on the NYSE (LCII). Its Lippert brand makes chassis, axles, slide-out systems, windows, doors, furniture, awnings and electronics for RV and trailer makers, with an aftermarket arm serving consumers and dealers. Major customers include Thor Industries and Forest River. Revenue is about US$3.8 billion. B2B brand with limited consumer recognition, though known in the RV community.

New York-based audience measurement company, taken private in 2022 by Elliott and Brookfield, providing the TV and digital ratings that are used as industry currency by advertisers and broadcasters. B2B brand, though widely cited in media, including in sports audience reporting. Also provides consumer data to advertisers and retailers worldwide, with offices in more than 100 countries. Nielsen's ratings are used to set advertising prices, and its reports cover sport, music and shopping behaviour worldwide.

New York-based advertising and marketing communications group, owning BBDO, DDB, TBWA, OMD, and, since 2025, Interpublic (McCann, FCB). Customers are large advertisers. Revenue about $17 billion. Listed on the NYSE (OMC). B2B brand, although its agencies handle high-profile sports campaigns. Employs about 75,000 staff and operates in over 100 countries. Agencies include sports marketing and media buying arms. Omnicom's clients include many of the world's largest brands, and the group has roughly 75,000 employees after the Interpublic deal.

wiki.title: Omnicom Group
wiki.text: Omnicom Group Inc. is an American multinational media, marketing, and corporate communications holding company headquartered in New York City. Its branded networks and specialty firms provide services in four disciplines: advertising, customer relationship management (CRM), public relations, and specialty services. The services included in these disciplines are media planning and buying, digital and interactive marketing, sports and events marketing, field marketing, and brand consultancy. Omnicom Group serves as the parent company of Omnicom Media Group, comprising the agencies OMD, PHD, and Hearts & Science, as well as the global advertisin

about: Warner Bros. Discovery is a US media and entertainment group headquartered in New York, formed in 2022 by the merger of WarnerMedia and Discovery. It owns Warner Bros. studios, HBO and Max streaming, CNN, TNT Sports, Discovery Channel, Eurosport and many other networks, earning from subscriptions, advertising and content licensing. Listed on Nasdaq (WBD) with revenue of about $40 billion and plans to split into two companies. It holds major sports rights, so it is relevant to advertising and F1-style broadcast partnerships.

wiki.title: Warner Bros. Discovery
wiki.what: Former American mass media and entertainment conglomerate
wiki.text: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in New York City. It was formed on April 8, 2022, by the merger of Discovery, Inc. with AT&T subsidiary WarnerMedia, with the latter being the successor of Kinney National Company and Time Inc. Warner Bros. Discovery operated via two divisions: Streaming & Studios and Global Linear Networks. Streaming & Studios included the flagship Warner Bros. studios, HBO, DC Entertainment, and streaming services such as HBO Max and Discovery+. Global Linear Networks largely included advertising-supported cable networks. Those networks were in

about: Marketing analytics and attribution platform for mobile apps, headquartered in San Francisco with Israeli roots (founded 2011). Brands and advertisers use it to measure ad performance and optimise campaigns, paying by subscription. Customers include large consumer apps. Funding about USD 300 million. B2B software with little consumer awareness, though known in advertising.

wiki.title: AppsFlyer
wiki.text: AppsFlyer is a privately owned data broker headquartered in San Francisco. The company collects and sells personal data through data and web scraping and other means of dataveillance, which other businesses could then use for targeted marketing and user profiling. In a 2025 lawsuit from NOYB, AppsFlyer was found operating as a de facto unregistered data broker in the European Union, in violation of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The company was found to be one of the two data brokers servicing TikTok, where private information were collected illegally to perform user analytics.

about: MFE-MediaForEurope is the pan-European broadcasting group formerly called Mediaset, headquartered in Cologno Monzese near Milan (and incorporated in the Netherlands), operating Canale 5, Italia 1 and Rete 4 in Italy, Telecinco in Spain, and a controlling stake in ProSiebenSat.1 in Germany. Controlled by the Berlusconi family's Fininvest. Listed in Milan and Madrid (MFE). Major consumer TV reach with advertising-led revenue.

Baidu is a Beijing-based Chinese internet and AI company operating China's largest search engine, along with the Ernie AI models, Apollo Go robotaxi service, iQIYI streaming and cloud services. Founded 2000 by Robin Li. Revenue is about 130 billion yuan, largely advertising plus AI cloud. Listed on Nasdaq (BIDU) and Hong Kong (9888). Huge consumer brand in China.

wiki.title: Baidu
wiki.text: Baidu, Inc. ( BY-doo; Chinese: 百度; pinyin: Bǎidù; lit. 'hundred times') is a Chinese multinational technology company specializing in internet services and artificial intelligence. It holds a leading share of China's search engine market via Baidu Search and provides other internet services, including Baidu App (its flagship app for search and newsfeed), Baidu Baike (a user-edited, Wikipedia-like encyclopedia), iQIYI (a video streaming service), Baidu Tieba (a forum platform similar to Reddit), and ES File Explorer. Besides its core internet search business, Baidu has diversified into autonomous driving (Baidu Apollo), smart consumer electron

about: Kantar is a London-based marketing data, insights and analytics company, formerly the research arm of WPP, sold in 2019 with Bain Capital controlling it, and it later sold Kantar Media to H.I.G. Capital. Offers consumer panels, brand tracking and advertising effectiveness measurement. Revenue is around 2 billion dollars. B2B brand known to marketers and agencies, including sports-sponsorship research.

wiki.title: Kantar
wiki.text: A kantar is the official Egyptian weight unit for measuring cotton. It corresponds to the US hundredweight, and is roughly equal to 99.05 pounds, or 45.02 kilograms. It is equal to either 157 kilograms of seed cotton or 50 kilograms of lint cotton.

about: Authentic Brands Group is a New York brand management and licensing company that buys consumer, sports and entertainment brands and licenses them to manufacturers and retailers. Its portfolio includes Reebok, Brooks Brothers, Sports Illustrated, Shaquille O'Neal, Marilyn Monroe, Elvis Presley, Juicy Couture, Ted Baker and Champion's apparel business. Revenue comes from royalties on over 30 billion dollars of retail sales. Founded in 2010 by Jamie Salter, privately held with investors including BlackRock and Brookfield. Portfolio brands are very visible even if the group is not.

wiki.title: Authentic Brands Group
wiki.what: American brand development and licensing company
wiki.text: Authentic Brands Group LLC (Authentic) is an American sports, media, entertainment and lifestyle platform headquartered in New York City. Its holdings include various fashion, athletics, and entertainment brands, which it licenses to operating partners around the world. Authentic owns more than 50 consumer brands, as well as the likeness rights or estates of celebrities, including Muhammad Ali, Elvis Presley, and Marilyn Monroe.

about: Disney Streaming, formerly BAMTech, was the Disney technology unit that powered streaming services such as Disney+, Hulu and ESPN+ and sold video technology to third parties. Based in New York, it was folded into Disney's wider media and entertainment organisation in the early 2020s. Customers are consumer subscribers and advertisers. Owned by Disney (NYSE: DIS). The streaming brands have enormous consumer visibility.

wiki.title: Disney Streaming
wiki.what: Subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company
wiki.text: Disney Streaming, formerly known as BAMTech Media (2015–2018) and Disney Streaming Services (2018–2021), is an American streaming technology subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company, with operations in Manhattan, New York City, and Burbank, California. Established in 2015 as a spin-off of MLB Advanced Media, the digital media arm of Major League Baseball (MLB), the company specializes in video on demand technology and infrastructure for over-the-top (OTT) media services. Its technology has supported streaming services operated by ESPN, the National Hockey League (NHL), and Blaze Media. BAMTech was initially majority-owned by MLB Advanced Media,

about: Monotype is a Woburn, Massachusetts typography and design company, long known for Helvetica, Arial and other fonts, and owner of the MyFonts, Fonts.com and Linotype libraries, which license fonts to brands, device makers and software developers. It also provides brand design services. It was a listed company, then taken private by HGGC in 2019 for about $825 million. Customers include Apple, Microsoft and major consumer brands. B2B design supplier, with high recognition in the design community but low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Monotyping
wiki.text: Monotyping is a type of printmaking made by drawing or painting on a smooth, non-absorbent surface. The surface, or matrix, was historically a copper etching plate, but in contemporary work it can vary from zinc or glass to acrylic glass. The image is then transferred onto a paper by pressing the two together, using a printing press, brayer, baren or by techniques such as rubbing with the back of a wooden spoon or the fingers which allow pressure to be controlled selectively. Monotypes can also be created by inking an entire surface and then, using brushes or rags, removing ink to create a subtractive image, e.g. creating lights from a field

wiki.title: Monotype Imaging
wiki.what: American typesetting and typeface design company
wiki.text: Monotype Imaging Holdings Inc., founded as Lanston Monotype Machine Company in 1887 in Philadelphia by Tolbert Lanston, is an American (historically Anglo-American) company that specializes in digital typesetting and typeface design for use with consumer electronics devices. Based in Woburn, Massachusetts, the company has been responsible for many developments in printing technology—in particular the Monotype machine, which was a fully mechanical hot metal typesetter, that produced texts automatically, all single type. Monotype was involved in the design and production of many typefaces in the 20th century. Monotype developed many of the most

about: Etsy is a Brooklyn, New York online marketplace, founded in 2005 and listed on Nasdaq (ETSY), where independent sellers sell handmade, vintage and craft goods. It also owns Reverb, Depop and Elo7, and earns revenue from listing and transaction fees, advertising and seller services. It has more than 90 million active buyers, with gross merchandise sales of around $13 billion. Strong consumer brand in the US, UK and Europe, with extensive marketing.

wiki.title: Etsy
wiki.what: E-commerce website focused on handmade or vintage items
wiki.text: Etsy, Inc. is an American e-commerce company focused on handmade or vintage items and craft supplies. Its marketplace includes categories such as jewelry, apparel, home decor, furniture, toys, and art. Items described as vintage must be at least 20 years old. The platform provides sellers with individual storefronts where they list their goods for a fee of US$0.20 per item. Since 2013, the company has allowed the sale of mass-manufactured items. As of December 31, 2024, Etsy's marketplace contained more than 100 million active listings and connected 8 million sellers with 96 million buyers. At the end of 2024, Etsy had 2,400 employees. In 202

about: Taboola is a New York-based content discovery and native advertising company, listed on Nasdaq (TBLA), founded in 2007 in Israel, that recommends articles and videos at the bottom of publisher sites such as news outlets and, through its Realize platform, helps advertisers reach audiences. It earns a share of advertising spend and has revenue of about $1.7 billion, and works with thousands of publishers including Yahoo and NBC News. B2B ad technology brand, with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Taboola
wiki.text: Taboola is a public advertising technology company headquartered in New York City. Founded in 2007 by Adam Singolda, who serves as its CEO, the company operates a digital advertising platform that connects advertisers with audiences across a network of publisher websites and digital properties. Taboola's platform uses machine learning techniques, including contextual and behavioral signals, to match advertisements and content recommendations with users on the open web.

about: Instacart (now Maplebear Inc., listed on Nasdaq as CART) is a San Francisco grocery delivery and pickup platform in the US and Canada working with thousands of retailers such as Costco, Kroger and Aldi. It earns delivery fees, retailer fees, advertising and enterprise software, with revenue of about $3.5 billion. It went public in 2023. Strong US consumer brand awareness, with advertising-led marketing.

wiki.title: Instacart
wiki.text: Maplebear Inc., doing business as Instacart, is an American retail media and delivery company based in San Francisco that operates a grocery delivery and pick-up service in the United States and Canada accessible via a website and mobile app. It allows customers to order groceries from participating retailers with the shopping being done by a personal shopper, who picks, packs, and delivers the order, while also providing alcohol delivery in regions where it is permitted. The company offers service from 2,200 retailers covering nearly 100,000 grocery stores, and works with 9,000 consumer packaged goods brands. Alcohol delivery is available fr

about: US enterprise software company in New York that sells a unified customer experience management platform, covering social media management, marketing, customer service, research and advertising for large brands. Customers include Microsoft, Samsung, P&G and many Fortune 500 companies, billed on subscriptions. Founded in 2009 by Ragy Thomas and listed on the NYSE (CXM) in 2021, with thousands of employees worldwide. B2B brand known to marketers and customer service teams.

wiki.title: Sprinklr
wiki.text: Sprinklr is an American software company that develops a software as a service (SaaS) customer experience management (CXM) platform. The company's software, also called Sprinklr, combines different applications for social media marketing, social advertising, content management, collaboration, employee advocacy, customer care, social media research, and social media monitoring. Sprinklr was founded in 2009 by technology executive Ragy Thomas. On June 23, 2021, the company went public on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol CXM, pricing 16.6 million shares at $16 each and raising approximately $266 million, valuing the company at roughl

about: US digital marketing network in New York, led by Mark Penn, that owns agencies and tech firms including Anomaly, 72andSunny, Code and Theory, The Harris Poll, Stagwell Marketing Cloud and Assembly. Customers are large brands, which pay for creative, media, data and digital transformation services. Listed on Nasdaq (STGW) with revenue of around 2.5 billion dollars. Strong in advertising and also has sports and entertainment marketing capabilities, but is a B2B holding brand.

wiki.title: Stagwell
wiki.text: Stagwell Inc., formerly The Stagwell Group, is a global marketing and communications group founded in 2015 by Mark Penn. In 2020, The Stagwell Group announced plans to merge with its affiliate MDC Partners. The merger was completed in August 2021. Known partners include 72 and Sunny, Left Field Labs, Anomaly, Doner, Forsman & Bodenfors, Code and Theory, Instrument, Locaria, Assembly, Gale, Allison Worldwide, SKDK (SKDKnickerbocker), HUNTER, Harris Poll, and NRG. In September 2025, Stagwell became the subject of media scrutiny after the investigative outlet Drop Site News published leaked internal strategy documents detailing the firm's public

about: Streaming platform company based in San Jose, California, listed on Nasdaq (ROKU), whose operating system powers Roku TVs and streaming players, with roughly 90 million streaming households. It earns most revenue from advertising on The Roku Channel and its home screen, plus platform fees and device sales. Founded in 2002 by Anthony Wood. Strong US consumer brand, a major advertising channel, and an established connected-TV partner for sports content.

wiki.title: Roku
wiki.text: Roku ( ROH-koo) is a brand of consumer electronics that includes digital media players, smart TVs (and their operating systems), as well as two streaming services (The Roku Channel and Howdy). The brand is owned by Roku, Inc., which is owned by Fox Corporation. As of 2024, Roku was the U.S. market leader in streaming video distribution, reaching nearly 145 million people.

about: The Trade Desk is a Ventura, California advertising technology company whose self-service demand-side platform lets agencies and brands buy digital ad inventory across connected TV, display, audio, mobile and retail media using data and AI tools (Kokai, Solimar and Unified ID 2.0). Customers are advertising agencies and large advertisers, and it earns a percentage of ad spend, with annual revenue of about 2.4 billion dollars. Founded in 2009 by Jeff Green and listed on Nasdaq (TTD), it has over 3,000 employees. B2B brand well known in advertising and finance circles, but not among general consumers.

wiki.title: The Trade Desk
wiki.what: U.S. ad exchange demand side platform
wiki.text: The Trade Desk, Inc. (TTD) is an American multinational technology company that produces and services programmatic marketing automation with personalized real-time digital content. Headquartered in Ventura, California, it is the largest independent demand-side platform (DSP) in the world. TTD operates with over 400 partners at more than 30 locations worldwide.

about: Alibaba Group is the Chinese e-commerce and technology conglomerate headquartered in Hangzhou, listed on the NYSE (BABA) and Hong Kong (9988). It runs Taobao, Tmall, AliExpress, Alibaba.com, Alipay via Ant (affiliate), Alibaba Cloud, Cainiao logistics, Lazada, Ele.me and others. Hundreds of millions of customers; revenue is around $135 billion. Founded in 1999 by Jack Ma. Global brand and a top Olympic sponsor until 2028.

wiki.title: Alibaba Group
wiki.text: Alibaba Group Holding Limited, branded as Alibaba (), is a Chinese multinational technology company specializing in e-commerce, retail, Internet, and technology. Founded on 28 June 1999 in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, the company provides consumer-to-consumer (C2C), business-to-consumer (B2C), and business-to-business (B2B) sales services via Chinese and global marketplaces, as well as local consumer, digital media and entertainment, logistics, and cloud computing services. It owns and operates a diverse portfolio of companies around the world in numerous business sectors. On 19 September 2014, Alibaba's American initial public offering (IPO) on the N

about: KTM is an Austrian motorcycle maker known for off-road, adventure and street bikes, and for its racing record in MotoGP, Moto2, Moto3, Dakar and motocross. It belongs to the former Pierer Mobility group, with Bajaj Auto of India holding the controlling stake after the 2024-25 restructuring. The data lists a Singapore address and funding of about 1.2B, which probably refers to a financing arrangement. Strong global motorsport brand with major sponsorship presence, and sells through dealers worldwide.
cb_desc: KTM is a European motorcycle manufacturer from Austri...

wiki.title: KTM
wiki.what: Austrian motorcycle and sports car manufacturer
wiki.text: KTM AG (German pronunciation: [ˌkɑːˌteːˈɛm]) is an Austrian motorcycle, bicycle and motorsports brand. It traces its foundation to 1934, as Kronreif & Trunkenpolz Mattighofen. Today, Bajaj Mobility AG (formerly Pierer Mobility AG) operates as the manufacturer of KTM-branded motorcycles, and KTM Fahrrad GmbH operates as the manufacturer of KTM-branded bicycles. KTM is known for its off-road motorcycles and as a reputed MotoGP constructor. In November 2025, it was announced that Bajaj Auto had completed the acquisition of a controlling stake in KTM for €800 million, increasing its indirect holding to approximately 75%.

about: Global private members' club and hospitality group with roughly 40 Soho Houses, beach clubs and co-working spaces in cities such as London, New York, Los Angeles and Miami, plus Soho Works, Soho Home furniture and Cecconi's restaurants. Members pay annual fees and spend on food, drink and stays; membership runs to hundreds of thousands. Founded by Nick Jones in 1995 in London, it listed on the NYSE (SHCO) in 2021 and agreed a 2025 take-private by MCR. Premium lifestyle brand with strong affluent-consumer visibility.

wiki.title: Soho House
wiki.what: House and museum in Birmingham, England
wiki.text: Soho House is a museum run by Birmingham Museums Trust, celebrating Matthew Boulton's life, his partnership with James Watt, his membership of the Lunar Society of Birmingham and his contribution to the Midlands Enlightenment and the Industrial Revolution. It is a Grade II* listed 18th-century house in Handsworth, part of Birmingham since 1911, but historically in the county of Staffordshire. It was the home of entrepreneur Matthew Boulton from 1766 until his death in 1809, and a regular meeting-place of the Lunar Society.

about: AC Milan is one of Europe's most successful football clubs, based in Milan, Italy, with seven European Cup and Champions League titles and 19 Serie A championships. It plays at the San Siro stadium, shared with Inter. Revenue, roughly 400 million euros a year, comes from broadcasting, commercial sponsorship and matchday sales. Sponsors include Emirates on the shirt and Puma as kit supplier. RedBird Capital Partners, led by Gerry Cardinale, bought the club from Elliott Management in 2022. Global fan base of hundreds of millions, and a long record of partnerships with major brands.

wiki.title: AC Milan
wiki.text: Associazione Calcio Milan (Italian pronunciation: [assotʃatˈtsjoːne ˈkaltʃo ˈmiːlan]), commonly referred to as simply Milan (Italian pronunciation: [ˈmiːlan]) in Italy or AC Milan outside of Italy, is an Italian professional football club based in Milan, Lombardy. Founded in 1899, the club competes in Serie A, the top tier of Italian football. In its early history, Milan played its home games in different grounds around the city before moving to its current stadium, the San Siro, in 1926. The stadium, which was built by Milan's second chairman, Piero Pirelli, and has been shared with Inter Milan since 1947, is the largest in Italian football,

about: English Premier League football club based in north London, playing at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, a 62,000-seat venue that also hosts NFL games and concerts. Revenue comes from broadcasting, matchday, commercial sponsorship (partners include AIA, Nike and Kia) and stadium events. The club is controlled by ENIC Group, led by Daniel Levy, and has a global fan base of hundreds of millions of followers. One of the best known football brands worldwide, with a very strong sponsorship platform.

wiki.title: Tottenham Hotspur F.C.
wiki.text: Tottenham Hotspur Football Club, commonly referred to as simply Tottenham ( TOT-ən-əm) or Spurs, is a professional football club based in Tottenham, North London, England. They compete in the Premier League, the top tier of English football. Since 2019, the team have played their home matches in the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. It was built on the same site as their previous home, White Hart Lane, which was demolished. Founded in 1882, Tottenham Hotspur's emblem is a cockerel standing upon a football, with the Latin motto Audere est Facere ("to dare is to do"). The team have traditionally worn white shirts and navy blue shorts as their home kit

about: Philips (Koninklijke Philips) is a Dutch health technology company based in Amsterdam, selling medical imaging, patient monitoring, sleep and respiratory devices, and personal health products such as Sonicare toothbrushes and Avent baby products. Revenue is about EUR 18bn with around 70,000 employees. It sold off its lighting arm (Signify) and TV business. Listed on Euronext Amsterdam and NYSE (PHG). A long-standing household brand with global recognition, and sports sponsorship history, including football's PSV Eindhoven.

wiki.title: Philips
wiki.text: Koninklijke Philips N.V., commonly known as Philips, is a Dutch multinational health technology company and former major consumer electronics manufacturer. The company was founded in Eindhoven in 1891 by Gerard Philips and his father Frederik Philips to manufacture incandescent light bulbs. In October 1997, Philips decided to move its corporate headquarters from Eindhoven to Amsterdam, with the relocation beginning the following year. The company's headquarters remain in Amsterdam. Philips was awarded the Dutch Royal designation by Queen Wilhelmina in 1916; Koninklijke became part of the company name in 1998. Through the 20th century, Philips

about: Ahmedabad-based flagship of the Adani Group, an incubator for new businesses including airports, roads, data centres, defence, copper and coal trading. Revenue about INR 1 trillion. Listed in India (ADANIENT). Strong group brand in India, with national visibility and sports sponsorship. Part of the Adani Group, led by Gautam Adani. The company is listed in India, runs a large portfolio of infrastructure projects and has built a high public profile across the country.

wiki.title: Adani Enterprises
wiki.what: Indian multinational holding company pvt ptd
wiki.text: Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL) is an Indian multinational publicly listed holding company and a part of Adani Group. It is headquartered in Ahmedabad and primarily involved in mining and trading of coal and iron ore. Through its various subsidiaries, it also has business interests in airport operations, edible oils, road, rail and water infrastructure, data centers, and solar manufacturing, among others.

about: Mountain View-based financial software company, founded 1983, selling TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma and Mailchimp to consumers and small businesses, with revenue of about $19 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (INTU). Very strong US consumer and small-business brand with heavy advertising, including Super Bowl spots and sports partnerships. Intuit has about 18,000 employees and more than 100 million customers across its products, and its brand is among the best-known software names in the US.

wiki.title: Intuit
wiki.text: Intuit Inc. is an American financial technology company that develops financial software and services, including TurboTax and QuickBooks. Founded in 1983, the company is headquartered in Mountain View, California. It went public in 1993 and that year acquired ChipSoft, maker of TurboTax. The company later expanded with the acquisitions of Credit Karma (completed in December 2020) and Mailchimp (completed in November 2021). Intuit has been the subject of reporting and regulatory actions related to U.S. tax filing. In 2019, ProPublica investigations found that Intuit had steered eligible taxpayers from its free IRS Free File product toward its

about: Data centre developer and operator of hyperscale campuses in North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America, supplying capacity to cloud and AI customers. Listed in the input as New York-based (operations centred in Colorado), and owned by DigitalBridge and Silver Lake. Funding and debt of about $36 billion. B2B infrastructure brand with no consumer awareness. Vantage's campuses include sites in Virginia, Texas, Arizona and Europe, and customers include large cloud providers.

London-based data centre developer, founded 2018, building and operating hyperscale campuses in Europe, with funding of about $4.2 billion shown. Customers are cloud providers and AI businesses. B2B infrastructure brand with no consumer awareness. Customers include cloud providers, AI companies and enterprises. The company has sites around London, Frankfurt and other European hubs. Pure DC's customers include hyperscale cloud providers, and it is owned by private investors.

Careem is a Dubai-based super app, founded in 2012 in Dubai, offering ride-hailing, food and grocery delivery, payments and mobility services across the Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan. Uber acquired its ride-hailing business in 2020 for $3.1 billion, and the rest runs under Careem Everything App owned partly by e& (Etisalat). It has raised about $870 million. Strong consumer brand in the region.

wiki.title: Careem
wiki.text: Careem is a Dubai-based super-app with operations in over 70 cities in 10 countries in the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia. It offers ride-hailing, bicycle rental, food delivery, grocery delivery, and digital wallets. It is 50.03% owned by e&, while its ridesharing company is wholly owned by Uber.

about: Privately owned insurance brokerage and risk management firm, founded in 1966 in Kansas City, and one of the world's largest independent brokers with offices worldwide. Customers are businesses and individuals buying commercial, employee benefits and personal insurance; revenue from commissions and fees. B2B with moderate corporate awareness.

wiki.title: Lockton
wiki.what: Village and civil parish in North Yorkshire, England
wiki.text: Lockton is a small village and civil parish in North Yorkshire, England. It is situated in the North York Moors about 4 miles (6.4 km) north-east of Pickering. Nearby villages include Newton-on-Rawcliffe and Levisham. The village is often used as a base by tourists visiting the nearby Dalby Forest, and Yorkshire Life magazine refers to the area as Yorkshire's "Capital of Cake".

about: Arthur J. Gallagher is a Rolling Meadows, Illinois insurance brokerage, risk management and consulting firm, founded in 1927, operating in about 130 countries with over 55,000 employees and revenue above $12 billion. Customers are corporations and individuals; revenue is commissions and fees. Listed on the NYSE (AJG). B2B broker, known in business circles, with some sports sponsorship in insurance.

wiki.title: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.
wiki.text: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. (Gallagher) is an American insurance brokerage and risk management services company based in Rolling Meadows, Illinois, a suburb of Chicago. The company provides insurance brokerage services (87% of 2025 revenues) and risk management services (13% of 2025 revenues), the latter of which primarily includes the processing of workers compensation and automobile insurance claims through the company's adjusters. The company is ranked 367th on the Fortune 500 and 192nd on the Forbes Global 2000. Founded in 1927, the company ranks among the world's largest insurance brokers.

about: Wipro is an Indian IT services and consulting company, headquartered in Bengaluru, with about 230,000 employees and revenue near 11 billion dollars, providing digital transformation, cloud, engineering and business process services to clients globally. Founded in 1945 and led by the Premji family. Listed on NSE and BSE (WIPRO) and the NYSE. B2B brand with high visibility and past sports sponsorship, including cricket.

wiki.title: Wipro
wiki.what: Multinational IT services and consulting company
wiki.text: Wipro Limited ( ) is an Indian multinational technology company based in Bengaluru. It provides information technology, consulting and business process services, and is one of India's Big Six IT services companies. Wipro's services include cloud computing, computer security, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, robotics, data analytics, and other technologies.

about: WTW (Willis Towers Watson) is a London-headquartered global advisory, broking and solutions company in human capital, health, benefits, risk and reinsurance, with about 48,000 employees and revenue near 9 billion dollars. Created by the 2016 merger of Willis Group and Towers Watson. Listed on Nasdaq (WTW). B2B brand with strong corporate recognition.

wiki.title: Willis Towers Watson
wiki.what: Global insurance broking and advisory company
wiki.text: Willis Towers Watson plc (branded as WTW) is a British-American multinational advisory, broking and solutions company. Its operations span commercial insurance brokerage and risk advisory, employee benefits and rewards consulting, retirement and actuarial services, and investment advice for pension funds and institutional investors. The company is legally domiciled in Ireland and has its principal executive offices at the Willis Building in London. In 2024 WTW reported revenue of US$9.93 billion and employed about 48,900 people. Following completion of the Willis Group - Towers Watson merger, the company was added to the S&P 500 index in Janu

about: Odoo is a Belgian open-source business software company, based near Louvain-la-Neuve, offering an all-in-one suite of apps for accounting, CRM, sales, inventory, manufacturing, e-commerce, HR and website building. It sells to small and medium-sized firms worldwide, earning money from subscriptions for hosted editions and from partner services. Founded in 2005 as TinyERP, with several million users. Raised funding from General Atlantic and others. B2B software with growing brand awareness among businesses, and it has sponsored sports teams, including cycling.

wiki.title: Odoo
wiki.what: Open source ERP, CRM and CMS
wiki.text: Odoo is a business management software suite developed in Belgium. It provides applications for customer relationship management, e-commerce, accounting, manufacturing, warehouse management, project management, and inventory management. In October 2022, Odoo S.A. announced changes to its pricing structure, including a single per-user subscription plan for access to its applications. Odoo is available in two editions: Community, released under the GNU LGPLv3 license, and Enterprise, which contains proprietary applications and support services. The software can be deployed on-premises or provided through a software-as-a-service (SaaS) model.

about: Sompo Holdings is a Japanese insurance group listed in Tokyo (8630), providing property and casualty insurance, life insurance, nursing care and overseas insurance through units such as Sompo Japan and Sompo International. The input lists Singapore, but the parent is headquartered in Tokyo, with Singapore as an Asia hub. It serves consumers and corporations worldwide and owns Van Gogh's Sunflowers. Revenue is around 4 trillion yen. Well known in Japan and a sports sponsor there, with moderate awareness elsewhere.

wiki.title: Sompo Japan
wiki.text: Sompo Japan, Inc. (損害保険ジャパン株式会社, Songai Hoken Japan Kabushiki-gaisha; lit. "General Insurance Japan"), formerly known as Sompo Japan Nipponkoa Insurance, Inc. (損害保険ジャパン日本興亜株式会社, Songai Hoken Japan Nihonkoa), is a Japanese insurance company. It is the second-largest property insurance company in Japan only behind Tokio Marine, with market share of 19.3% in 2007. As of 2010, the company is a wholly owned subsidiary of SOMPO Holdings. The “Sompo” in the company's name means “general insurance" (損害保険, songai hoken) in Japanese, though Sompo Japan offers a range of financial services including life insurance, securities, asset management and ventu

about: Ingram Micro is one of the world's largest technology distributors and service providers, supplying IT hardware, software, cloud, cybersecurity and logistics services to resellers and managed service providers in over 50 countries. Founded in 1979 and based in Irvine, California, it was owned by the Chinese conglomerate HNA and then Platinum Equity (2021) before returning to the NYSE (INGM) in 2024. Revenue is above 45 billion dollars. B2B distributor with brand awareness in the IT trade, but not among consumers.

wiki.title: Ingram Micro
wiki.text: Ingram Micro Holding Corporation is an American distributor of information technology products and services. The company is based in Irvine, California, U.S., and has operations around the world. Founded as Micro D, Inc. in 1979 in California by Geza Czige and Lorraine Mecca, the company was originally a traditional distributor focused on marketing, selling, and shipping vendor products to resellers. It has since repositioned itself as a platform-based business centered on its business-to-business (B2B) digital experience platform. As one of the world's largest technology distributors, Ingram Micro purchases hardware, software, and cloud serv

about: Quest Global is a Singapore-headquartered engineering services company founded in 2003 in India, providing product design, development and manufacturing engineering for aerospace, automotive, rail, energy, medical devices, semiconductors and industrial clients. It has over 20,000 engineers across dozens of centres worldwide. Private, with investors including Bain Capital and Advent International. B2B engineering services provider with modest public awareness but credibility in aerospace and mobility.

wiki.title: Quest Global
wiki.text: Quest Global (formerly QuEST Global) is an engineering services company with its headquarters in Singapore. Founded in 1997 by Ajit Prabhu and Aravind Melligeri, it serves clients in industries such as aerospace, automotive, and energy. As of 2025, it employed more than 23,000 people across more than 104 locations in 17 countries.

about: Remy Cointreau is a French premium spirits group based in Paris, owning cognac Remy Martin and Louis XIII, the orange liqueur Cointreau, Metaxa, The Botanist gin, Bruichladdich and other whisky brands. It sells to consumers via distributors, with big exposure to China and the US, and revenue near 1 billion euros. Founded in 1724 as Remy Martin, it is listed on Euronext Paris (RCO). High-visibility luxury drinks brands, active in hospitality and sports sponsorship.

wiki.title: Rémy Cointreau
wiki.text: Rémy Cointreau is a French, family-owned business group specialized in the production and distribution of alcoholic beverages. The group's products include cognac (Rémy Martin, Louis XIII), triple sec (Cointreau), the Greek spirit Metaxa, rum (Mount Gay), brandy (St-Rémy), gin (The Botanist) and whisky (Bruichladdich, Port Charlotte, Westland, Domaine des Hautes Alpes). The group, whose origins date back to 1724, was formed in 1990 after the merger of Rémy Martin and Cointreau. Rémy Cointreau also owns the fragrance company Maison Psyché.

about: Unit4 is a Dutch enterprise software company headquartered in Utrecht, selling cloud ERP and financial management applications focused on people-centric sectors such as professional services, education, the public sector, non-profits and real estate. It has roughly 4,000 employees and serves customers in many countries. Founded in 1980 and owned by private equity Advent International since 2021, previously TA Associates. B2B software vendor with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Unit4
wiki.text: Unit4 is an Enterprise Resource Software company that designs and delivers enterprise software and ERP applications and related professional services for people in services organizations, with a special focus on the professional services, education, public services, and nonprofit sectors. It has subsidiaries and offices in 23 countries across Europe, North America, the Asia-Pacific region and Africa. The company is best known for its People Experience Suite including Unit4 ERP, Unit4 Financials, Unit4 FP&A, and Unit4 Talent Management. In 2015, Unit4 announced a partnership with Microsoft to build self-driving business applications on the Mic

about: Atos is a French multinational IT services and digital transformation company, offering consulting, cybersecurity, cloud, managed infrastructure, data centre and big data and supercomputing (Eviden) solutions to enterprises and governments. Headquartered in Bezons near Paris, with around 100,000 employees and revenue of roughly 10 billion euros. Listed on Euronext Paris (ATO). Atos went through a major financial restructuring in 2024 and has been selling units. It has long been a major IT partner of the Olympic and Paralympic Games. Mostly B2B brand with sports-partnership experience.

wiki.title: Atos
wiki.text: Atos SE is a European multinational information technology (IT) service and consulting company with headquarters in Bezons suburb of Paris, France, and offices worldwide. It specialises in hi-tech transactional services, unified communications, cloud, big data and cybersecurity services. Atos operates worldwide under the brands Atos, Syntel, and Eviden.

about: Legal & General is a British financial services company, one of the largest in the UK, providing life insurance, pensions, annuities, retirement solutions and asset management through Legal & General Investment Management. It also invests in housing and urban regeneration. Headquartered in London, founded in 1836, with roughly 12,000 employees and managing over 1 trillion pounds of assets. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (LGEN), FTSE 100. Well-known British consumer finance brand with the umbrella logo and a history of sponsorship in sport.

wiki.title: Legal & General
wiki.text: Legal & General Group plc, commonly known as Legal & General or L&G, is a British multinational financial services and asset management company headquartered in London, England. Its products and services include investment management, lifetime mortgages (a form of equity release), pensions, annuities, and life insurance. As of January 2020, it no longer provides general insurance following the sale of Legal & General Insurance to Allianz, a portfolio that primarily included home insurance and a small number of pet insurance policies. Legal & General is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index. Legal & Gen

about: Brightline Trains is a Miami-based passenger rail operator running higher-speed intercity trains between Miami, Fort Lauderdale, West Palm Beach and Orlando, with a planned extension to Tampa, plus Brightline West between Las Vegas and Southern California. Owned by Fortress Investment Group's rail business, formerly Florida East Coast Industries. Revenue comes from ticket sales and real estate. Strong consumer brand in Florida, with growing visibility.

Concentrix is a customer experience (CX) outsourcing and technology company, headquartered in Newark, California and listed on Nasdaq as CNXC, spun off from Synnex in 2020. It runs contact centers and digital services for large clients in technology, retail, banking, healthcare and telecoms, and merged with Webhelp in 2023. It has around 450,000 employees across more than 70 countries and revenue of about $9-10 billion. B2B service provider with little consumer awareness but significant scale.

wiki.title: Concentrix
wiki.what: Business services company headquartered in Newark, California, US
wiki.text: Concentrix Corporation is an American business process outsourcing company headquartered in Newark, California, USA. It was a subsidiary of SYNNEX Corporation (NYSE: SNX) since 2006 and went public as an independent company on December 1, 2020. In 2025, Concentrix made it to number 426 on the Fortune 500 list. Concentrix is a global technology and services leader with membership in MRPCA and Insights Association.

about: Ayvens is a Rueil-Malmaison, France-based vehicle leasing and fleet management company, formed in 2023 by the merger of ALD Automotive and LeasePlan, and majority owned by Societe Generale. It leases and manages roughly 3 million vehicles in over 40 countries for corporate fleets, SMEs and individuals, and also offers flexible subscription services and used car sales. Listed on Euronext Paris (AYV). Revenue and its fleet size are among the largest in the world. B2B-led brand with growing consumer subscription visibility.

wiki.title: Ayvens
wiki.what: French fleet managing and operational car leasing company
wiki.text: Ayvens, formerly ALD Automotive, is a French fleet managing and operational car leasing company and a majority owned subsidiary of Société Générale. The company is active internationally and manages around 3.42 million vehicles. With a direct presence in 42 countries and with top 3 positions in 26 countries, ALD Automotive is ranked #3 worldwide and #1 in Europe by number of contracts under management and excluding OEM captives as at 31 December 2017 with around 1.5 million full service vehicle leasing and fleet management service contracts. The company also sells former lease fleet vehicles to consumers through its ALD Carmarket brand. In 20
